notes.purpose: First panel meant to answer a question rather than to exercise the code: do the mutations change the zinc site beyond what two WT simulations differ by?
notes.design: 4 scenarios x 2 replicas = 16 simulations of 20 ns (1001 frames each): 8 WT trajectories = 28 WT-vs-WT pairs for the null control. wt_model (K2K) is the modelled-WT control.
notes.cost: 320 ns in total, about 5000 atoms per system. Roughly 8 days on a laptop GPU at 40 ns/day; under a day on a recent CUDA GPU. Disk: about 5 GB.
notes.launch: bash scripts/run_panel_workflow.sh configs/znf_panel_20ns.json   (set CONDA_ENV_NAME; re-run the same command to resume; CONTROL_SCENARIO=wt_model uses the modelled WT as baseline in the consensus)
notes.to_extend: Raise prod_steps and re-run: finished simulations are extended, not redone.
